name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-node-book
query: CREATE (b1: Book {Title: 'Story Book', Condition: 'New', Cost: 450, Type: 'Novel'}), (b2: Book {Title: 'DBMS', Condition: 'New', Cost: 600, Type: 'Journal'})

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-node-person
query: CREATE (p1: Person {Name: 'Amit Sharma', Role: 'Author'}), (p2: Person {Name: 'Neha Patil', Role: 'Reader'}), (p3: Person {Name: 'Rahul Joshi', Role: 'Reviewer'})

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-rel-published-by
query:
MATCH (b1: Book {Title: 'Story Book'}), (b2: Book {Title: 'DBMS'}), (pub1: Publisher {Name: 'Oxford Publications'}), (pub2: Publisher {Name: 'Pearson Education'})

CREATE (b1)-[:PUBLISHED_BY]->(pub1),
       (b2)-[:PUBLISHED_BY]->(pub2)

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-rel-authored
query:
MATCH  (b1: Book {Title: 'Story Book'}),
	   (author: Person {Name: 'Amit Sharma'})
	   
CREATE (author)-[:AUTHORED]->(b1)

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-rel-reviewed-by
query:
MATCH  (b1: Book {Title: 'Story Book'}), 
	   (b2: Book {Title: 'DBMS'}), 
	   (p3: Person {Name: 'Rahul Joshi'})

CREATE (b1)-[:REVIEWED_BY]->(p3),
       (b2)-[:REVIEWED_BY]->(p3)

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-rel-returned-by
query:
MATCH  (b1: Book {Title: 'Story Book'}),
	   (reader1: Person {Name: 'Neha Patil'})
	   
CREATE (b1)-[:RETURNED_BY]->(reader1)

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-create-rel-issued-by
query:
MATCH  (b1: Book {Title: 'Story Book'}), 
	   (b2: Book {Title: 'DBMS'}), 
	   (reader1: Person {Name: 'Neha Patil'})
	  
CREATE (b1)-[:ISSUED_BY]->(reader1),
       (b2)-[:ISSUED_BY]->(reader1)

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-query-list-people-who-issued-book
query: MATCH (p: Person)<-[:ISSUED_BY]-(b: Book) WHERE b.Title = "Story Book" RETURN p;

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-query-count-people-who-issued-book
query: MATCH (p: Person)<-[:ISSUED_BY]-(b: Book) WHERE b.Title = "Story Book" RETURN count(p) AS NumberOfPeople;

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-query-list-publishers-from-pune-city
query: MATCH (p: Publisher) WHERE p.City = "Pune" RETURN p.Name;

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-query-find-book-publisher
query: MATCH (b: Book {Title: 'Story Book'})-[:PUBLISHED_BY]->(p: Publisher) RETURN p.Name;

name: neo4j-assign-1-q1-query-update-book-cost
query: MATCH (b: Book {Title: 'Story Book'}) SET b.Cost = 500 RETURN b.Title, b.Cost;
